evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.991 Torr at 100 sccm Ar near the end of the ramp.
Growth began at 3.002 Torr; subsequent pressure readings rose monotonically.
Pressure reached 3.339 Torr, approximately 11% above growth onset despite unchanged setpoints.
Temperature 750.2 °C and Ar flow 100.1 sccm closely match setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm.
No exhaust oxygen sensor is installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: Check expected growth-stage pressure behavior, independently confirm pressure, and test exhaust conductance and seal integrity to distinguish restriction from leakage or gauge error; oxygen measurement is needed to verify atmosphere purity, and sample characterization is not yet available.
